document_api_meta.title: Search Size Charts
document_api_meta.env_desc: Retrieve size charts that a seller has created.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: page_size
request_query_param.desc:
The number of results to be returned per page. 
Valid range: [1-100]

request_query_param.name: page_token
request_query_param.desc: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. Retrieve this value from the result of the `next_page_token` from a previous response. It is not needed for the first page.

request_query_param.name: locales
request_query_param.desc:
The BCP-47 locale codes for displaying the size charts.
Default: The default locale of your shop.
Possible values:
- de-DE
- en-GB
- en-IE
- en-US
- es-ES
- es-MX
- fr-FR
- id-ID
- it-IT
- ja-JP
- ms-MY
- pt-BR
- th-TH
- vi-VN
- zh-CN

request_body_param.name: ids
request_body_param.desc:
Filter size charts by size chart template IDs. 
Max: 50 IDs

request_body_param.name: keyword
request_body_param.desc:
Filter size charts by size chart template name or by key words in the template name.
Keyword searches do not return PRODUCT_SCOPED size charts because they do not have a template name.
If both ids and keyword are provided, ids takes priority.

request_body_param.name: size_chart_mode
request_body_param.desc: Filter size charts by usage mode. Possible values: REUSABLE_TEMPLATE: A size chart template that can be reused across multiple products. PRODUCT_SCOPED: A size chart created for and used by a single product. If omitted, the existing search behavior is preserved.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: request_id
response_param.desc: Request log

response_param.name: data
response_param.desc: Specific return information

response_param.name: ^size_chart
response_param.desc: The list of size charts that meet the query conditions.

response_param.name: ^^template_id
response_param.desc: The size chart template ID.

response_param.name: ^^template_name
response_param.desc: The size chart template name.

response_param.name: ^^images
response_param.desc: The list of images included in a size chart.

response_param.name: ^^^uri
response_param.desc: The URI to identify the image in API requests and responses.

response_param.name: ^^^url
response_param.desc: The URL to access and view the image.

response_param.name: ^^^locale
response_param.desc: The language of the size chart image.

response_param.name: ^^related_category_ids
response_param.desc: Leaf category IDs applicable to this size chart.

response_param.name: ^^size_chart_datas
response_param.desc: Localized structured size chart data. Each item contains a locale and the structured data for that locale.

response_param.name: ^^^locale
response_param.desc: The language of the size chart table.

response_param.name: ^^^size_chart_data
response_param.desc: Structured size chart data for the specified locale.

response_param.name: ^^^^table
response_param.desc: Structured table containing headers and rows.

response_param.name: ^^^^^headers
response_param.desc: Ordered header definitions.

response_param.name: ^^^^^^name
response_param.desc: Header display name.

response_param.name: ^^^^^^id
response_param.desc: Standard size-system ID or measurement key.

response_param.name: ^^^^^rows
response_param.desc: Rows of the size chart.

response_param.name: ^^^^^^cells
response_param.desc: Cells aligned by index with table.headers.

response_param.name: ^^^^^^^value
response_param.desc: Cell value.

response_param.name: ^^^^description
response_param.desc: Additional size chart description.

response_param.name: ^^^^is_one_size
response_param.desc: Whether this is a one-size chart.

response_param.name: ^^^^measurement_type
response_param.desc: Possible values: GENERIC_MEASUREMENTS: generic measurements; BODY_MEASUREMENTS: shopper body measurements; PRODUCT_MEASUREMENTS: finished-product measurements.

response_param.name: ^^^^unit_system
response_param.desc: Possible values: METRIC: metric units; IMPERIAL: imperial units.

response_param.name: ^^^^size_types
response_param.desc: Possible values include: size_chart_common_size_type: Common; size_chart_size_type_regular: Regular; size_chart_size_type_juniors: Juniors; size_chart_size_type_plus: Plus; size_chart_size_type_big&tall: Big & Tall; size_chart_size_type_petite: Petite. Available values depend on the category.

response_param.name: ^^size_chart_mode
response_param.desc: Filter size charts by usage mode. Possible values: REUSABLE_TEMPLATE: A size chart template that can be reused across multiple products. PRODUCT_SCOPED: A size chart created for and used by a single product. If omitted, the existing search behavior is preserved.

response_param.name: ^^target_regions
response_param.desc: Target country or market codes recorded for this size chart, used for localized content and images. The list may include historical targets. Omitted when no target regions are recorded; omission does not mean worldwide support. This field does not determine product publishing eligibility.

response_param.name: ^next_page_token
response_param.desc: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. If this value is non-empty, pass it in the `page_token` parameter of the next request. An empty value means there are no more results.

response_param.name: ^total_count
response_param.desc: The number of size charts that meet the query conditions.
